jobs.title: English Teacher Eye Level Sunter
jobs.description: Requirements : Candidates with at least D3/S1 in English Literature, English Education Literature, or equivalent. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Required skill(s): Teaching English, time management, and communication. Fluent in English; written and spoken. Love teaching and being able to teach English to children aged 4-15 years old. Familiar with children and teens. Has initiative to introduce the Eye Level program. Honest, disciplined, committed, communicative, attractive, creative, hard-worker, and tech-savvy. Maintaining an neat yet professional look is a plus. Willing to work onsite. General Responsibilities : Teaching English to children aged 4-15 years old. Provide quality academic coaching in a small group setting, according to Eye Level philosophy, methods, curriculum, and individual progress plan. Communicate effectively and professionally with students, parents, and staff. Motivate and encourage students. Grading and maintaining progress reports for each student. Performs administrative activities if needed. Notify the Center Director of any problems or concerns.

jobs.title: Math Teacher Eye Level PIK 2
jobs.description: Requirements : Minimum D3/S1, preferably in Mathematics, Mathematics Education, English Education, English Literature, or related fields. Experienced in teaching Primary and Secondary students, preferably in an international school or international curriculum environment. Able to explain mathematical concepts clearly, patiently, and systematically. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Teaching or tutoring experience is a plus. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Patient, disciplined, honest, responsible, committed, creative, and proactive. Tech-savvy and able to adapt to a structured learning environment. Willing to introduce and promote the Eye Level learning program to students and parents. Willing to undergo Eye Level training and follow the Eye Level teaching methodology. Well-groomed and professional in appearance. Willing to work onsite. General Responsibilities : Teach Mathematics to children aged 4-15 years old according to the Eye Level curriculum and teaching methodology. Provide academic coaching in a small-group learning environment based on each student's individual progress. Explain mathematical concepts clearly and guide students to develop independent learning skills. Motivate and encourage students throughout their learning process. Monitor, grade, and maintain students' academic progress and learning reports. Communicate effectively and professionally with students, parents, and Center staff. Introduce and explain the Eye Level program to prospective students and parents when needed. Perform administrative and operational activities related to teaching when required. Identify and report students' learning difficulties or other concerns to the Center Director. Participate actively in Eye Level training and other center activities.

jobs.description: Remote | Independent Contractor | Get certified for future project opportunities Prove your skills. Get certified. Be ready for what comes next. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. Demonstrate your skills now and be considered when project opportunities become available. What You Will Do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. What You Bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. What the Work Looks Like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Why Get Certified Now Completing certification in advance allows you to demonstrate your qualifications and be considered for relevant independent contractor engagements when opportunities become available.
